description: Delivery team hooks: session config check, pipeline enforcement, source code enforcement, retrospective enforcement, empirical validation, GDScript parse checking, agent prompt audit, skill load verification

hooks.prompt: Check if this session involved delivery-flow pipeline work. Look for: Stage references, .delivery/ artifacts written, pipeline execution context, story implementations. If delivery-flow pipeline work occurred, check if the post-pipeline protocol completed: (1) retrospective was run, (2) memory file written to .delivery/memory/, (3) defect review completed if defects were found. If pipeline work occurred but post-pipeline protocol was skipped or incomplete, return 'block' with reason: 'Post-pipeline protocol not completed. The retrospective, memory write, and defect review are mandatory after every pipeline run. Complete these before ending the session.' If no pipeline work occurred in this session, or if the post-pipeline protocol is complete, return 'approve'.

Check if this Skill invocation is for a delivery-team implementation skill (developer, godot, quality). Look at $TOOL_INPUT for the skill name. If the skill being invoked is delivery-team:developer, delivery-team:godot, or delivery-team:quality for implementation work (writing code, fixing bugs, refactoring), check: does .delivery/config.yml exist in the current working directory? If implementation work is being requested outside an active delivery pipeline (no .delivery/config.yml), return deny with reason: 'Implementation should go through the delivery-flow pipeline for QA review, DoD validation, and defect prevention. Run delivery-team:delivery-flow first, or say "skip pipeline" to proceed without quality gates.' If .delivery/config.yml exists, or if this is not an implementation skill (e.g., delivery-team:delivery-flow, delivery-team:product-delivery, delivery-team:architect, delivery-team:ui, delivery-team:operations, delivery-team:user-feedback), return allow.
